about: Carwash anthem (AW-STUDY-0060). One take is a whole run: each section is one station of the carwash, so the music and the stage change together. Instrumental, real produced audio (no MIDI); original, not a cover.

identity.permitted_reuse: Abbie's World game, trailers and soundtrack (ElevenLabs paid-plan terms, indie game under $500k revenue); not for film, TV or radio

positive: polished 1970s-inspired funk production, live band feel, warm analog sound
wonder, warmth, optimism and a little mischief

cues.title: Wash Day Anthem (carwash, 4 minutes)

trace.instrumentation: handclaps, wah guitar, funky bass, clavinet, Rhodes, brass stabs, congas, strings
trace.original_work: original 1970s-style disco funk; inspired by the feel of carwash anthems, not a cover or imitation of any song

sections: vinyl-warm intro, handclaps count in, bass walks up to the one
tight funk groove, wah guitar chicks on the offbeat, water-drip percussion
bubbly Rhodes and clavinet, bouncing bass, shaker, playful horn stabs answer each other
full groove, driving drums, big brass riff in 3+3+2, handclaps on 2 and 4, string swoops
breakdown, bass and congas, filtered sweep, tension rising
groove returns smooth and shiny, wah guitar solo, hi-hat shimmer
sparkling vibraphone and glockenspiel, light and proud, bass keeps the groove
big brass hit, final riff, rings out on a clean D major chord
